$comment: The first grass a player ever walks into, carrying a level SIX starter and nothing else. It used to top out at six and seven -- level parity -- and in this game's early damage curve parity is a coin flip: a solo starter won only 37 to 52 percent of top-of-band fights here. Worse, gale, chitin and spark all beat Verdant while resisting it, and they carried 47 of the 100 encounter weight, so the Sprigling player specifically lost 11%, 1% and 0% of fights against Pipwing, Nettlebug and Sootmoth. Two changes: the two neutral Beast slots keep a 3-5 band and take the bulk of the weight, while the three starter-counters drop to 3-4 and get rarer. Mean wild level falls 4.61 -> 3.82, so about a sixth less experience per fight, in exchange for 86-94 percent win rates instead of 63-79.
